tuning_rule: Largest mean accepted squared jump in affine coordinates among proposals with acceptance between 0.3 and 0.9; if none, smallest step. Acquired target only. Save frozen settings before evaluation.
target: Same original bounded nonlinear likelihood and prior as nonlinear_posterior_v1. Fixed invertible Gauss-Newton affine coordinates per case; constant determinant cancels. Gradient drift with full forward/reverse Metropolis ratio. Reject out-of-bound proposals, never clip.
diagnostics: Maximum rank/folded split Rhat <=1.01, min bulk and 5/95 tail ESS>=400 over all whitened coordinates, log target and mean foreground density/acquired/withheld projections. Withheld summaries evaluation only. No interval claims on failure.
scope: One further feasibility run only, one CPU thread, deadline checked every transition. Separate tuning case, no evaluation retuning or automatic extension.
